_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment: never edit shillinq_register.json or other fragments. ADR-031: a customer's payment term and delivery method are plain data with defaults.
_meta.description: Gives CustomerMaster the payment term, delivery method and invoice address every new invoice for that customer reads (REQ-SIS-005). The fragment moves CustomerMaster to 0.4.0; it sorts after billable-period-becomes-an-invoice, which set 0.3.0. It also gives ARInvoice the sending group the invoice send writes after the mailer or the Peppol send answered (REQ-SIS-001, REQ-SIS-002); ARInvoice's version moves in zz-financial-documents-linked-objects, which has the last word on it. It declares InvoiceBatch, the batch a send of selected invoices records its outcomes on (REQ-SIS-003).

paymentTermDays.title: Payment term (days)
paymentTermDays.description: How many days after the invoice date an invoice for this customer is due. A new invoice takes its due date from it.

deliveryMethod.title: Delivery method
deliveryMethod.description: How an invoice reaches this customer: by email, through Peppol, by post, or not at all.

invoiceEmail.title: Invoice email
invoiceEmail.description: The address invoices are mailed to. Empty uses the customer's email address.

sending.title: Sending
sending.description: How and when the invoice reached the customer. Written by the send only after the mailer or the Peppol send answered.

sentVia.title: Sent via
sentVia.description: The way the invoice went out, or post or none when nothing was sent from shillinq.

sentTo.title: Sent to
sentTo.description: The email address, or the Peppol transmission id.

sentAt.title: Sent at
sentAt.description: When the mailer or the Peppol send accepted the invoice. Empty for post and none.

attempts.title: Attempts
attempts.description: How many times a send was tried.

lastError.title: Last error
lastError.description: Why the last send failed; empty after a send that went out.

note.title: Note
note.description: What the user is told besides: that a post invoice is printed by hand, or that Peppol fell back to email.

InvoiceBatch.title: Invoice Batch
InvoiceBatch.description: A batch of sales invoices: a send batch mails the selected issued invoices in a queued job and records one outcome per invoice (sent, skipped with a reason, or failed with the error). The bookkeeper who asked is notified when it is done.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: create writes one invoice per customer; send mails the selected invoices.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: The administration the invoices belong to.

requestedBy.title: Requested by
requestedBy.description: The user who started the batch; notified when it is done.

charge.title: Charge
charge.description: The lines a create batch bills to every customer.

invoiceIds.title: Invoices
invoiceIds.description: The invoices the batch sends, at most 200.

resend.title: Resend
resend.description: Whether an invoice that was already sent goes again.

outcomes.title: Outcomes
outcomes.description: One row per invoice: invoiceId, status (sent, skipped or failed) and the reason.

state.title: State
state.description: queued until the job starts, running while it sends, done when every invoice has an outcome.

done.description: Tell the bookkeeper who started the batch that every invoice has an outcome.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a SEPA Mandate is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.
